speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome)

The combination of parkinsonian features like rigidity and tremor with prominent autonomic failure (orthostatic hypotension, urinary incontinence) and cerebellar signs (gait difficulty, slurred speech) points to an atypical parkinsonian disorder. Did you notice your tremors are "pill-rolling" or rather a rest tremor, and does your speech sound more like a whisper or have a scanning quality?
